Description: Home business - no customer visits. Reiki - Reiki is a practice that supports overall balance to the whole system: physical, spiritual, mental and emotional. Our human bodies are amazing, it naturally knows how to heal itself, but our busy lifestyle keeps us in reactive sympathetic nervous system (SNS) mode, where the body’s priority is just to get through the day, coping (fight or flight), not healing. Reiki is performed by the practitioner placing their hands just off the body or gently directly on the body. The practitioner maintains a meditative presence and allows the healing energy to flow to where the client needs it. Reiki can also be done long-distance. Distance Reiki can be sent to anyone, anywhere. It is a healing energy that connects the practitioner and client on an energetic level where the healing work is conducted. Energy is not limited by distance.
